summary: This directory manages the transformation, analysis, and rendering of schema information into guide documentation. It provides the structures and logic required to normalize schema definitions, process associated annotations, and serialize the resulting data into YAML format.
responsibilities: Normalizing schema ASTs into guide node representations
Rendering guide nodes into YAML-formatted strings
Defining core data types for schema guide structures
relationships: The normalization process transforms schema ASTs into a consistent guide node structure.
Annotation checks are aggregated into specific records that integrate with guide nodes.
Guide nodes serve as the primary input for the YAML rendering service.
designDecisions: Use of union types to represent diverse schema node kinds
Configuration-based normalization to support flexible schema processing
Separation of schema representation from output formatting
